source: Compendex with retained paired Inspec projection
objective: Complete the deferred Pilot 002 comparison of current literal A1 against one conservative three-family trailing-wildcard candidate. Preserve the Compendex and Inspec totals and stable accessions separately.

scope.inspec_projection: Retained because the fixed Engineering Village route selects both databases. It is reported separately and never combined with Compendex.
scope.extrapolation: No result is extrapolated to another partition. A later partition requires its own predeclared complete set comparison.

date_window.cutoff_handling: Screen records in the cutoff year against the later exact common cutoff.

controls.native_ris: required for every retained record in each strict pass

adapter.source_affecting_dependency_closure: The two named adapter files are pinned. The adapter version identifies its reviewed sibling dependencies.

replacements.coverage_basis: Engineering Village documents trailing * as zero or more characters. The live set comparison remains required before adoption.

unchanged_elements: All field wrappers and Boolean relationships
English, Published, database, sort, page-size, and no-facet controls

source_contract.asterisk: zero or more characters anywhere in a word; terminal * is truncation
source_contract.minimum_prefix: two non-wildcard characters in ordinary fields
source_contract.autostemming: visibly off and verified by the adapter
source_contract.known_live_boundary: The reviewed adapter semantics audit found a positive Compendex nanosatellit* known-item contrast with an unstemmed plural negative.

acceptance_checks: The literal event completes two independent source-exhaustive paired passes before the candidate is submitted.
The wildcard event completes the same strict two-pass contract with identical controls.
Each event has an exact source query echo, native RIS reconciliation, and separate Compendex and Inspec stable-accession projections.
The candidate Compendex projection contains every literal Compendex accession.
A zero candidate-only Compendex set permits A1-only adoption. Any candidate-only record requires explicit assessment before adoption.
A missing literal accession, incomplete event, control mismatch, or source failure rejects the candidate.
No count equality alone is treated as set evidence.
No wildcard is adopted for another partition from this A1 comparison.
stop_rules: Stop without submitting the wildcard event if the literal strict event fails.
Stop after any source failure. Do not retry, narrow, infer a count, or reuse partial records.
Retain every failure as an explicit non-mergeable null receipt.
